data_type: modeled (weather-driven GDD reconstruction)
weather_station: GHCN-D USC00129430 W LAFAYETTE 6 NW; backups USW00014835/USC00124715/USC00124711
sowing_source: Modeled: first workable day on/after 5 Oct (<2.5 mm rain that day, <12.7 mm over prior 3 days), window set after the Hessian fly-free date (Purdue University, https://www.purdue.edu/newsroom/archive/releases/2012/Q4/specialist-warns-wheat-farmers-to-observe-fly-free-planting-dates.html); weather from NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/); not calibrated to farm sowing data (+/-10 d)
emergence_source: Modeled: 120 degC-d (base 0 degC) after sowing, generic wheat thermal-time assumption; weather from NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/); not validated
flowering_source: Modeled: 849 degC-d (base 0 degC) from 1 Jan = heading threshold 779 degC-d calibrated on 7 observed nursery heading dates + 70 degC-d; calibration data: USDA-ARS Uniform Eastern Soft Red Winter Wheat Nursery reports, Lafayette IN, 2000-2015 (https://www.ars.usda.gov/ARSUserFiles/20500000/ue0203.pdf and companion years); weather from NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/); heading MAE 2 d (leave-one-out 2.6 d); within USA-NPN winter wheat flowering window 700-900 GDD (USA National Phenology Network, Winter Wheat Development Forecast)
maturity_source: Modeled: 750 degC-d (base 0 degC) after flowering, typical SRWW grain-fill duration; checked indirectly via harvest = maturity + 7 d vs 6 observed nursery harvests (MAE 4.5 d); calibration data: USDA-ARS Uniform Eastern Soft Red Winter Wheat Nursery reports, Lafayette IN, 2000-2015 (https://www.ars.usda.gov/ARSUserFiles/20500000/ue0203.pdf and companion years); weather from NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/)
method_reference: Claude reconstruction following SciSpace session design (https://scispace.com/share/566cc82c-1ea5-4841-9124-d3aeeb6f57ef); code: tippecanoe_wheat_gdd_model.js
